title: Ecopath model of the Southern Bight of the North Sea (version 3)
authors: Steven Pint; Martha Stevens; Marleen De Troch; Dick van Oevelen; Johanna Jacomina Heymans; Gert Everaert
documentation_evidence: 37-page report includes basic inputs, diets pp15 onward, fleets and balanced model. Associated DOI 10.14284/668 archive describes input data, R scripts and food web models; actual native-file contents require inspection.
loadability_evidence: Native .eweaccdb model files, numeric parameter/diet/catch CSVs, and supporting R scripts downloaded and ZIP member names inspected. No EwE database load test conducted.
loadability_class: C — parameter and diet tables inspected; model import not tested
quality_rationale: VLIZ PDF title verified37pages. Table4 PDF23 unbalanced estimates, Table5 PDF27 balancing steps. ZIP inspected: Data/Ecopath parameters.csv, Data/diet IVc.csv, catches, SBNS_1991_balanced.eweaccdb, SBNS_1991_adjusted.eweaccdb and R scripts. Native database available but NOT load-tested. Full model import and numerical reconstruction remain untested.
extraction_readiness: Parameter and diet tables located; transcription and balance audit required
geometry_method: No defensible digital study boundary located
recommendation: Southern Bight of North Sea, ICES IVc, 63,633.86 km²; base year 1991.
coverage_note: Southern Bight of North Sea, ICES IVc, 63,633.86 km²; base year 1991.
